newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia stocks down by close, more losses seen.
newsitem.headline: Estonia stocks down by close, more losses seen.

text.p: Most Estonian shares eased again on Tuesday, with dealers expecting further slides in prices in the coming days after the market's recent record run.
Total trade on the main list was 92.3 million kroons with the Talse 1.27 percent lower to close at 345.54.
"There were more sellers about today and most banking stocks could keep moving lower tomorrow," one trader said.
Hansapank was the most active stock with 38.6 million kroons traded to be 1.75 lower at 190.75 kroons despite an upward revision to its profit forecast for 1997.
"The selling pressure started in the morning in Hansapank, and except for a small jump after the release of the revised profit figures the selling pressure stayed," one dealer said.
"We are seeing some profit-taking in Hansapank now and because August is expected to be slow, the price will just ease down," another said.
Hansapank revised its profit estimates for 1997 and predicted a new group profit 475 million kroons up from 320 million kroons.
Drugs firm Farmaatsiatehase moved slightly higher with some bigger blocks taking it against the downward trend.
Farma closed at 135 kroons, up 0.25 kroons after turning over 18.2 million kroons.
On the free market, 6.7 million kroons changed hands with Norma, an automotive safety belt manufacturer, the most active.
Norma lost 1.50 kroons to close at 88.50 kroons after trade of 2.8 million kroons despite increasing its 1997 forecast.
